findings.title: Apply communication_support to the communication subject, not arbitrary spoken/written output
findings.detail: Q-1015 explicitly asks for a signal inviting a team for tea in RU/EN/TR but lacks communication_support. Q-1129 only asks to write a cosy word/detail yet includes communication_support; Q-1115 only chooses an arbitrary humorous dialogue subject but is also tagged communication. The taxonomy explicitly includes inviting and excludes generic answer/write and arbitrary dialogue without a communication subject. With the communication topic excluded, candidate-only any-tag simulation incorrectly allows Q-1015 and blocks Q-1129/Q-1115. Q-1047 and TD-1117 are positive substantive invitation controls.
findings.required_fix: Correct classifications or issue a precise justified new taxonomy revision; audit all communication assignments against the subject/procedure distinction. Preserve Q-1115 uncontrolled-topic flag; do not treat it as a guarantee over subsequent free speech.

findings.title: Include actual manufactured object characters in the topic union
findings.detail: YB-1026 tells the story of a postcard that goes on holiday by itself; Q-1063 makes a seed packet speak for future flowers. These manufactured stationery/package characters are explicit across RU/EN/TR but everyday_objects is absent. This is not incidental stationery used to write an answer: the object itself is the character. Excluding everyday_objects would still permit both service prompts.
findings.required_fix: Add the missing subject tags in a new candidate revision and audit analogous object characters. Keep food on lids/jars contextual rather than assuming all containers are food.

findings.title: Resolve the household-drop classification against the stated nature boundary
findings.detail: YB-1066 asks for sports commentary about a single drop falling from a household tap in all three locales. nature_animals is present although the taxonomy excludes/qualifies a household drop without a natural comparison. No nature comparison appears; the sports-commentary framing supports leisure/humor/creative and tap supports objects. Excluding nature blocks this prompt without a stated natural subject. The wording need not in the taxonomy leaves discretion, but the rationale supplies no exception and the guide calls this a subject taxonomy.
findings.required_fix: Remove nature for this source or explicitly revise and justify a consistent water/household-drop boundary before promotion. Audit similar drops separately; do not silently redefine all water as nature under the existing digest.
